name: Camera Shutter Dump
summary: Stack twelve photos into a collage on black, one per camera shutter sound, as editable Image clips with bundled shutter effects.

compatibility.selects: Needs the editor's existing original Image placement service (same as Four Photo Reveal), public clip effects and Audio overlays; no Node.js. Verified in Selects Staging and a local develop build on 2026-09-30: saved Draft readback and HD export. The Node-free panel (2026-10-01) passed its local tests but has not yet been run in the app. Windows (2026-10-02): the shutter sounds are decoded through the host FileSystem and Web Crypto, with no shell command; a Windows pass on the Staging build is pending.
